kind: the execution event view, as measured

reader.backingCapability: @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl (mounted in a bare Cordis Context) + readColdSessionLog from @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query
reader.whyAScriptNotSrc: Palimpsest's own node_modules contains no @deepseek-ai/* package; the installed DSH lives at ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/. A src/ module importing an absolute profile path would make the product source depend on one machine's deployment layout, so the reader lives in scripts/ and resolves the DSH home at call time.

measuredRealRead.selectionMethod: read the candidates and scored their event kinds — never modification time, never filename similarity
measuredRealRead.boundedRead: a maxEvents=5 page returned exactly seqs [0,1,2,3,4] while knownEventCount stayed 37 — the page is a real bound, not a full replay relabelled
measuredRealRead.seqLocality: DSH seq numbers are local to the session and are never merged into a global sequence
measuredRealRead.sanitization: the page contains no 'arguments', no message content, no stream and no environment value; a tool/call exposes only the tool NAME and its step

measuredReadFailures.note: an absent id is reported as absent, never as an empty event stream

measuredReadFailures.evidenceClass: vocabulary member; the DSH reader balances an interrupted final turn in memory and reports the recovered prefix

measuredReadFailures.note: no reader composed ⇒ an explicit page, so the session lifecycle is IDENTIFIED_NOT_READ rather than NO_SESSION_BOUND

errorClassificationSource: SessionQueryError.code (SESSION_QUERY_SESSION_NOT_FOUND / SOURCE_CONFLICT / CORRUPT_SESSION / PERSISTENCE_FAILED / INVALID_SURFACE) and the persistence error classes (SessionPersistenceNotFoundError, SessionPersistenceCorruptionError, SessionFormatUnsupportedError), read from the installed declarations at @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query/lib/types/config.d.ts and @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js

requiredEventCases.by: fixture — two calls, one result; the unmatched call is present and is never inferred to have succeeded
fixture — observedStatus 'failed', never flattened to a completed message
fixture — a step/end with no observedStatus; completion is never inferred from a step boundary
real DSH read (permission/preset, sandbox/mode, …) + fixture; referenced by exact seq, never dropped, never interpreted
fixture — an empty page with READ_OK and the true knownEventCount
fixture — an empty page with the true knownEventCount
fixture — inheritedEventCount 3 marks seqs 0-2 as inherited and seq 3 as child-owned; the parent is a SESSION relation, never a Work delegation edge

eventIdentity.sequencesNotMerged: DSH seq is local to the Session; Work project_sequence is local to the Project; Host Observation sequence is local to the Port Invocation. V0 never merges them into one invented global sequence.
eventIdentity.inheritability: the inherited flag comes from the source's own inheritedEventCount, so an inherited fork event is distinguishable from a child-owned one

sensitiveContent.rawInspection: deferred to a future separately-authorized capability
sensitiveContent.measuredAbsence: the serialized page contains none of the fixture secrets (PRIVATE / SECRET / PAYLOAD) and no 'arguments' key

boundedReading.measuredCost: the DSH reader reads the session's stored log through the handle seam; the page bound limits what is RETURNED, and the tests measure the page, not a claim of incremental I/O
